column1: # Test 7's attribution of accepted-and-ASan-dirty audit-corpus programs (scripts/test7.sh leg (b);
# scripts/test7/classify.py reads it). One row per program or glob, first match wins:
#   <path relative to the corpus root, fnmatch glob>
# <row> is an audit row (A1..A57, B1..B9, C1..C14: plans/backlog/OWNERSHIP_BORROWING_ORIGINS_AUDIT.md §3),
# `new:<issue basename>` for a hole filed after the audit, or `none:<reason>` for a dirty run that is not a
# memory-safety hole of the checker (say why). A reproducer under repros/ needs no row: its basename names
# its audit row. A dirty program with no row is UNATTRIBUTED and blocks the claim until it is triaged here.
